slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

systems.tiers: the essay's table gives pilots in 30 districts and 160 linked hospitals, with more than 28,000 births registered digitally to a central database (2026), launched in 19 districts in August 2025; district and municipal registry offices otherwise on paper forms

note: The essay's Somalia rows describe paper recording at clinics, schools, police stations and district or municipal registry offices and a civil registration pilot; none states whether a local government office has a connection of its own. The registration system is an application, so it gives no fact here.
